children: Lakeshore Acquisition III received a $67,500 extension payment and extended its deadline to complete an initial business combination to October 1, 2026.
CPRO Electronics Co. Ltd. wired a $67,500 second extension payment to the trust account on Aug. 26, 2026.
The payment triggered a one-month extension of the deadline from Sept. 1, 2026 to Oct. 1, 2026.
Extension affects timing for consummating the SPAC's initial business combination under the May 22, 2026 merger agreement.
